Measure non-uniqueness and empirical stability across discovered circuits.

    Optional labels in exactly the same component order as the masks.
confidence:
    Confidence level for Wilson intervals over inclusion frequency.
stable_threshold:
    A component belongs to the empirical stable core only when the lower

verification certificate over a continuous input domain or dataset edit
neighbourhood.

Build a neuron-group wiring graph from an ε-sufficient circuit core.

Nodes are retained (optionally removed) unit groups from
``discover_decision_circuitry``. Edges between consecutive Linear layers
use the measured mass:

    mass(G → H) = Σ_{i∈G, j∈H} |W_{j i}| · |a_i|

where ``a`` is the captured input activation to the downstream Linear layer
and ``W`` is that layer's weight matrix. This is not a claim of unique
causal edges; it is the measured weight×activation coupling of the core.

Printable / plottable anatomy of Linear layers on one live forward pass.

For each selected ``nn.Linear`` layer with weight ``W`` and bias ``b``, and
captured pre-layer input ``a``:

* pre-activation output ``z = W a + b``
* input contribution proxy ``c = a ⊙ ∂||z||²/∂a``
* outgoing column energy ``||W[:, j]||₂`` and incoming row energy ``||W[j, :]||₂``

Claims are local and measurement-backed. They are not synaptic “reasoning”.
